title: Weekly Park Visits Linked to Children's Wellbeing
paragraphs: Do children need parks? A new study says yes. Parks may help children feel better.
Scientists in England looked at 4,219 children. The children were between 4 and 11 years old. Some went to the park every week. Some went less often.
The children who went every week did better in mental health tests. But this does not prove the park is the reason.

questions.q: How many children were in the study?
Does the study prove the park is the reason?
questions.a: No, it does not prove it.
